items.context: @TheMoonShow (21.460 seguidores, en inglés): dice que solo el 46% de la oferta de $BTC está en ganancia y que el MVRV Z-Score bajó a 0,24, ambos cerca de mínimos de cuatro años, y pregunta si Bitcoin se acerca a un piso importante. Post de ~50 min con 583 vistas y 0 respuestas: cuenta mediana, pregunta abierta y MVRV, respondible con el índice Market Temperature.
items.suggested_text:
An MVRV Z-Score of 0.24 means price is sitting only slightly above the network's aggregate cost basis, its realized value. That's the zone where selling increasingly comes from holders at a loss rather than from profit-taking, which is why readings like this tend to appear late in a drawdown, not early.

One metric on its own is noisy, though. The Market Temperature index I track blends MVRV with price vs. the 200-week average, the drawdown from the all-time high and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum, 25% each. It went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days: https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122727211610542288

Cold readings have historically lined up with better long-term entries than hot ones. What they have never told anyone is how long the market stays cold, and that part usually ends up mattering more than the exact low.
